# axm agents instructions enable

Deprecated alias for `axm rules enable`

## When to use

Deprecated alias for `axm rules enable`

## Usage

```bash
axm agents instructions enable [flags]
```

## Arguments

None.

## Flags

| Name          | Type    | Required | Description                                                                   |
| ------------- | ------- | -------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `--scope`     | choice  | No       | Enable project (default) or user-level configuration (choices: project, user) |
| `--file`      | string  | No       | Source-of-truth instruction file                                              |
| `--gitignore` | boolean | No       | Manage propagated files in .gitignore                                         |

Global flags are documented on [Global flags](../../global-flags).

## Examples

**Enable instruction files**

```bash
axm rules enable
```

**Enable without writing gitignore entries**

```bash
axm rules enable --no-gitignore
```

## Requirements

None.

## Side effects

None.
